properties.name: After calibration, one named hole inside the Riemann or Navier–Stokes map is worked: a sub-problem where partial progress is real and checkable, never the whole problem
properties.statement: Once the method has been calibrated on a known answer, it is turned on one named hole inside the Riemann Hypothesis map or the Navier–Stokes map, scoped to a sub-problem where partial progress is real and checkable (extending a computed range, sharpening a known bound, closing one conditional step). The "map, not attempt" choice for the full problems stands. Nothing reads proven on the agent's word alone.
